name: Job
holds: what the unit does for the reader: answer something work raised, keep track of something ongoing, take in a document, find their way through many items, or work on what they bring
test: code every job the unit does, at first paint or on an address that carries a payload; a unit that does two jobs carries both, and neither is primary

name: Answer
holds: what the reader gives back on the unit
test: a control on the unit records the reader's judgment of what it shows, and the unit writes it where the work that raised it can read it: a repository, a store or a reply address; browser storage and the clipboard do not count

name: Body
holds: the unit's main arrangement at first paint, at desktop width
test: the region that would remain if every control were removed

name: Frame
holds: how the reader chooses what the body shows
test: the control changes what the body holds, not how it looks

name: Reach
holds: what one tap on the body opens
test: the thing opens over or beside the body, rather than replacing the unit

name: Binding
holds: how the body's regions, or the body and its reach, are tied

name: Phone
test: compare the two screenshots, or read the breakpoint in code

name: Ring
holds: how far the unit sits from the Web Tools app's center
test: the declaration the unit's ring_basis names
